notes.title: PAX East 2025
notes.notes:
Rhapsodogs, I'm going to be attending PAX East 2025 at my publisher Top Hat Studios' booth showcasing [b]Tales of Tuscany[/b] alongside some other cool games by Top Hat! If you're attending this year, you're definitely going to want to stop by.

I'll also be selling [b]Thunder Goober Plush[/b], [b]Mystery Rhapsodies[/b], and [b]Thunder Goober Stickers[/b]!!!

PAX is always my favorite time of year when I get to connect with lots of Rhapsodogs IRL - if you're one of the awesome community members who've travelled in the past to see my game, thank you so much! I appreciate you, and can't wait to see you all this year too!

notes.title: New Game Reveal! Tales of Tuscany
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi Rhapsodogs![/h3]

Whether you've played any game I've made previously, or this is your first time seeing an RPG from me - I'm super grateful that you're checking out my new game Tales of Tuscany. This game is not a sequel, but shares the same universe as another game called Athenian Rhapsody.

If you haven't played AR or have no idea what anything is in that game, don't worry - ToT is equally if not even more enjoyable for you too.

I love to make content about my RPG's and connect with my community, who I call the Rhapsodogs. You can find all of my content here: [url=https://linktr.ee/athenianrhapsody]https://linktr.ee/athenianrhapsody[/url]

I'm going to be posting both here and on my social medias all about Tales of Tuscany and my goals for the game - this is a choose your own adventure, and my mission is to empower players and bring them together using our unique Rhapsody system. (Basically trading cards you generate in-game from playing!)

I'm planning on hosting a livestream to answer all of your questions and show off the game soon. What do you guys want to see me cover about the game? What are you looking forward to seeing? I'd love to connect with you guys and show you everything I can about the new game!
